{{Quote|When this resurgent Empire demanded our allegiance, my ancestors attempted to extend the same offer of neutrality they had found acceptable in the past. We only served to anger them. They bombarded our world from space, sinking nearly every last surface structure, Ahto City included.|Representative Shuuru's personal journal|<ref name="Since KOTOR" />}}
The '''Devastation of Manaan''' was an act carried out by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], sometime between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]]. After [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of hiding in [[Seat of The Empire|sectors]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] unexplored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] and initiated their crusade against the Republic's member worlds and other planets. In their campaign for dominance, the Empire traveled to the [[Water/Legends|water]] world of Manaan, a planet known for its staunch devotion to neutrality during periods of war. The Sith refused to accept the native [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath's]] tradition of impartiality and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded the planet]], destroying almost all of Manaan's free-floating surface structures. As a result, the Selkath [[Species/Legends|species]] entered a period of extreme isolation from the galaxy, and it was many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before they reestablished contact with the rest of galactic civilization, though they remained wary of both the Republic and the Sith Empire.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Horrifying reports from the Outer Rim seemed to portend the utter destruction of the Republic.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] describes the Sith onslaught|<ref name="date" />}}
[[File:Manaan.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Manaan, as seen from orbit]]
After several [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the [[Seat of The Empire|far reaches]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|revealed]] themselves and their [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|rebuilt Empire]] to an unsuspecting [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in [[3681 BBY]], sparking the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Timeline 6">These events are witnessed in ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', which takes place twenty-eight years before the ratification of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty was drafted and signed in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> The conflict between the Sith and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] saw the Imperials achieve major victories while the Republic crumbled under [[Politics/Legends|political]] infighting and [[Galactic economy|economic]] depression.<ref name="Republic">{{Holonet|allegiances|galactic-republic|The Galactic Republic}}</ref>

During the war, the Empire also came into conflict with fiercely independent societies, such as the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. Manaan was a [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered planet with a long avowed neutrality during instances of galactic conflict<ref name="Manaan, old setting" />—during the [[Jedi Civil War]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]] era, the [[Species/Legends|native]] Selkath managed to maintain their impartiality and broker their [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] healing agent to both the Republic and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The Empire, seeking to take sole the source of kolto, demanded Manaan's allegiance. The Selkath instead responded with an offer of neutrality similar to the one used during the Jedi Civil War, but the offer only angered the Empire.<ref name="Since KOTOR" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|With their inaction in our time of need, the Republic delivered the finishing blow—and this without having fired a single shot. Betrayed and embittered, we retreated to the depths, no longer willing to associate with any offworlders in any way. To us, they were all slavers. Abductors of our children. Calm-water friends at best.|Shuuru's datalog|<ref name="Since KOTOR" />}}
In response to the Selkath's proposal of neutrality, the Empire [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] Manaan from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], sinking almost every surface structure—including their capital of [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]].<ref name="Since KOTOR" /> During the attack, [[Vinyor Tesh]]'s [[Vinyor Tesh's mother|mother]] and [[Vinyor Tesh's father|father]], who were both researchers based on the planet, were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Laotah]] was visiting the planet at the time and took the young orphan to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a Jedi at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Tesh">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Master Vinyor Tesh}}</ref> The Republic was unable to lend aid on account of their being at war, and feeling betrayed, the Selkath retreated back into the [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] of Manaan in a mass exodus, leaving their floating cities abandoned and in ruins.<ref name="Since KOTOR" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|After all, what guarantees do we have that either side would remain at arm's length if left unchecked?|Shuuru's datalog|<ref name="Since KOTOR" />}}
The Sith attack, which historians later labeled as "the Devastation of Manaan,"<ref name="Report">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210730|text=Intelligence Report: Historical Analysis of Manaan|int=Intelligence Report: Historical Analysis of Manaan}}</ref> and lack of Republic aid gave rise to feelings of hostility towards off-worlders among the Selkath, who came to consider all foreigners—regardless of whether they were of the Empire or Republic—as [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and enemies. The Selkath spent many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in isolation from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]-using [[Order of Shasa]] came to power as Selkath's protectors. In their isolation, Selkath culture thrived, but some began to seek the economic benefits that came from trade with off-worlders.<ref name="Since KOTOR" /> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] diplomat [[Mahreen]] spent several years convincing a delegation of the Order of Shasa to meet with her;<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mercantile Plaza of Manaan}}</ref> the Selkath also found their economy to be declining and began discussing the issue amongst themselves.<ref name="Since KOTOR" />

When they finally decided to end their isolation, Mahreen convinced the Selkath to convert one of the few remaining surface structures into the [[Mercantile Plaza]],<ref name="Codex" /> a trading plaza with strict rules as to who was granted landing privileges. At first only ambassadors from the Republic were permitted, but the Selkath politician [[Shuuru]] eventually extended an invitation to the Sith Empire, as he distrusted the Republic due to their inactivity in Manaan's time of need.<ref name="Since KOTOR" /> Ahto City remained in ruins for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], and the Selkath established the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]] as a fledgling defense force for their planet, though the intelligence forces of the Sith Empire considered the organization to be insufficient to repel an invasion.<ref name="Report" /> Around [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> the Sith Empire began marshalling their forces to [[Invasion of Manaan|invade]] the planet in their [[Third Galactic War|ongoing renewed war]] with the Republic; the Empire's [[Dark Council]] considered the act to be retribution for the planet's refusal to adequately share their kolto reserves.<ref name="Report" />

==Behind the scenes==
The devastation of Manaan was first mentioned on the official website for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information could be found on "[http://www.swtor.com/info/story/setting The Setting]," a webpage intended to provide background on the game's historical period. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the text that was originally located there. "The Setting" was updated mid-[[2011]], and the information on Manaan was removed.<ref name="Manaan, old setting" /> It was later expanded on in promotional material for Game Update 2.9 of ''The Old Republic'', which introduced a Flashpoint based on Manaan,<ref name="Since KOTOR" /> and in entries of the in-game Codex discussing Manaan.<ref name="Codex" /> An in-universe intelligence report, posted on the game's official website on [[July 30]], [[2021]] as part of the setup for the forthcoming [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion, [[canon]]ized the event's name.<ref name="Report" />
